-- Scoreosis ranked contract v1. The game and the Scoreosis verifier run this
-- same module, so every rule here decides verified scores and achievements.
-- A ranked run is one stage; the stage id is the run's mode and its board.
local sim = require "modules.sim"
local stages = require "modules.stages"

local M = {}

M.contract = 1
-- A tick's input holds up to three sim input codes (1-15) applied in order
-- before the tick: first + 16 * second + 256 * third.
M.buttons = 12
M.modes = {}
for i, id in ipairs(stages.order) do M.modes[i] = id end

M.achievements = {
	{ id = "clear_any", fact = "cleared", mode = "run", gte = 1, name = "First Stop", description = "Clear any stage." },
	{ id = "clear_6", fact = "cleared", mode = "run", gte = 6, name = "Halfway Home", description = "Clear stage 6 or a later one." },
	{ id = "clear_12", fact = "cleared", mode = "run", gte = 12, name = "Relief", description = "Clear the final stage." },
	{ id = "flawless", fact = "flawless", mode = "run", gte = 1, name = "Iron Gut", description = "Clear a stage without taking a hit." },
	{ id = "deathless", fact = "deathless", mode = "run", gte = 1, name = "No Second Chances", description = "Clear a stage without a checkpoint respawn." },
	{ id = "combo_8", fact = "best_combo", mode = "run", gte = 8, name = "Max Combo", description = "Reach the x8 dodge combo." },
	{ id = "dodges_100", fact = "dodges", mode = "total", gte = 100, name = "Sidestepper", description = "Dodge 100 hazards." },
	{ id = "leaps_25", fact = "leaps", mode = "total", gte = 25, name = "Long Jumper", description = "Leap clean over 25 hazards." },
	{ id = "nears_50", fact = "nears", mode = "total", gte = 50, name = "Close Shave", description = "Dodge 50 hazards by a hair." },
	{ id = "pickups_25", fact = "pickups", mode = "total", gte = 25, name = "Antacid Fan", description = "Collect 25 pickups." },
	{ id = "clenches_100", fact = "clenches", mode = "total", gte = 100, name = "Iron Will", description = "Clench 100 times." },
	{ id = "score_100k", fact = "score", mode = "total", gte = 100000, name = "Career Commuter", description = "Earn 100,000 points across runs." },
}

function M.new(_, mode)
	local s = { events = {} }
	sim.new_run(s, stages.get(mode or "") and mode or stages.order[1])
	s.events = {}
	return s
end

-- One tick: the recorded codes, then the sim. `step` drops the events the
-- verifier never presents; the game presents them (main/controller.script).
function M.advance(s, code)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local c = code % 16
		if c ~= 0 then sim.input(s, c) end
		code = (code - c) / 16
	end
	sim.tick(s)
end

function M.step(s, code)
	M.advance(s, code)
	s.events = {}
end

function M.finished(s)
	return s.run_state ~= "run"
end

function M.facts(s)
	local facts = {}
	for name, value in pairs(s.facts) do facts[name] = math.floor(value) end
	local cleared = s.facts.cleared > 0
	facts.score = math.floor(s.points.value)
	facts.flawless = (cleared and s.facts.hits == 0) and 1 or 0
	facts.deathless = (cleared and s.facts.respawns == 0) and 1 or 0
	return facts
end

function M.save(s)
	return sim.save(s)
end

function M.load(data)
	return sim.load({}, data)
end

return M
modules.modules.score:
local cfg = require "modules.config"
local M = {}

function M.new()
  return { value = 0, combo = 0, furthest = 0, awarded = {}, streak = 0, stride_at = 0, clench_at = 0 }
end

function M.distance(s, distance)
  if distance > s.furthest then
    s.value = s.value + (distance - s.furthest) * cfg.score_dist
    s.furthest = distance
  end
end

function M.reward(s, id, points, combo)
  if s.awarded[id] then return false end
  s.awarded[id] = true
  if combo then s.combo = math.min(cfg.combo_max, s.combo + 1) end
  s.value = s.value + points * (combo and s.combo or 1)
  return true
end

function M.stride(s, accepted, distance)
  if not accepted then s.streak = 0; return end
  if distance <= s.stride_at or distance < s.furthest then return end
  s.stride_at = distance
  s.streak = s.streak + 1
  if s.streak % cfg.streak_length == 0 then
    M.reward(s, "stride:" .. s.streak .. ":" .. math.floor(distance), cfg.score_streak)
  end
end

function M.clench(s, distance)
  if distance < s.furthest or distance - s.clench_at < cfg.clench_score_distance then return false end
  s.clench_at = distance
  s.value = s.value + cfg.score_clench
  return true
end

function M.hit(s)
  s.combo, s.streak = 0, 0
end

return M
modules.modules.sim:
-- EBAKUW8 gameplay at a fixed 60 Hz, pure Lua. `s` is the controller instance (or
-- a plain table on the Scoreosis verifier). Everything that decides a run lives
-- here; the controller only renders it, drains `s.events` and maps input to
-- M.input codes. Ranked play replays these same functions on the server.
local stride     = require "modules.stride"
local cfg        = require "modules.config"
local stages     = require "modules.stages"
local hazards    = require "modules.hazards"
local spawner    = require "modules.spawner"
local difficulty = require "modules.difficulty"
local CUT        = require "modules.cutscenes"
local scoring    = require "modules.score"
local stairs     = require "modules.stairs"

local M = {}
M.DT = 1 / 60

-- Input codes. 7..10 sync both held legs from touch: M.hold(l, r). CLEAR drops
-- held input (screen changes, focus loss).
M.L_DOWN, M.L_UP, M.R_DOWN, M.R_UP, M.CLENCH, M.SKIP, M.CLEAR = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11
function M.hold(l, r) return 7 + (l and 1 or 0) + (r and 2 or 0) end

local function emit(s, kind, e)
  e = e or {}
  e.kind = kind
  s.events[#s.events + 1] = e
end

local function sfx(s, name) emit(s, "sfx", { name = name }) end

local function home_x(s) return (s.dir == 1) and cfg.hero_x or (cfg.disp_w - cfg.hero_x) end

function M.new_facts()
  return { cleared = 0, hits = 0, dodges = 0, pickups = 0, leaps = 0, nears = 0, clenches = 0,
    respawns = 0, best_combo = 0 }
end

function M.clear_input(s)
  s.down = { L = false, R = false }
  s.touches = {}
  s.both_held_t = 0
  s.jump_armed = true
  s.pending_stride = nil
end

local function clear_hazards(s)
  s.hazards = {}
  emit(s, "cleared")
end

-- behavior registry: id -> per-tick extra motion (on top of the world scroll).
local BEHAVIOR = {
  static        = function() end,
  move_straight = function(s, h, dt) h.x = h.x - s.dir * h.spec.speed * dt end,
  fall          = function(_, h, dt) h.y = h.y - h.spec.speed * dt end,
}

-- ---------- hazards ----------

local function spawn(s, name, event)
  local spec = hazards[name]
  if not spec then return end
  local margin = math.max(120, spec.w / 2 + 32)
  local x = (s.dir == 1) and (cfg.disp_w + margin) or -margin
  local y = spec.y
  if s.mode == "stairs" then x, y = stairs.x[event.lane], 760 end
  local h = { x = x, y = y, name = name, spec = spec, group = spec.group,
    hit = false, event_id = event.seq, stairs = s.mode == "stairs" }
  if spec.behavior == "fall" or h.stairs then h.warned, h.warn_t = true, 0.55 end
  table.insert(s.hazards, h)
  emit(s, "spawned", { h = h })
  -- the goal ends the level when the hero REACHES its x (so jumping/missing it still wins):
  -- distance advances at the same rate the goal scrolls toward the hero.
  if spec.group == "goal" then s.goal_reach = s.distance + math.abs(x - s.hero_x) end
end

-- AABB the hero against every hazard. One-shots (danger/pickup/goal) fire once; slow
-- is continuous. Returns true if the hero is in a slow zone this tick.
local function collide(s)
  if s.dev then return false end                  -- godmode: no penalties, no goal-win in dev
  local hx, hy = s.hero_x, s.hero_y
  local in_slow = false
  for _, h in ipairs(s.hazards) do
    local sp = h.spec
    if math.abs(hx - h.x) < (cfg.hero_hw + sp.w * 0.5) then
      -- a danger that overlaps the STANDING hero's lane here was a real threat, so a clean
      -- clear counts as a dodge; falling/off-lane hazards never set this (no phantom dodges)
      if sp.group == "danger" and not h.hit and math.abs(cfg.hero_y - h.y) < (cfg.hero_hh + sp.h * 0.5) then
        h.threatened = true
      end
      if math.abs(hy - h.y) < (cfg.hero_hh + sp.h * 0.5) then
        if sp.group == "slow" then
          in_slow = true
        elseif sp.group == "danger" and not h.hit then
          h.hit = true
          s.meter = s.meter - cfg.danger_penalty
          s.stride.speed = math.max(s.stride.cfg.speed_floor, s.stride.speed - cfg.danger_stagger)
          scoring.hit(s.points)
          s.facts.hits = s.facts.hits + 1
          emit(s, "hit")
          sfx(s, "hit")
          s.stumble_t = .25
        elseif sp.group == "pickup" and not h.hit then
          h.hit = true; h.dead = true
          s.meter = math.min(1, s.meter + (sp.refill or cfg.refill))
          if scoring.reward(s.points, "pickup:" .. h.event_id, cfg.score_pickup) then s.facts.pickups = s.facts.pickups + 1 end
          sfx(s, "pickup")
        end
      elseif sp.group == "danger" and hy > h.y then
        if s.airborne and s.leaping and sp.leapable then h.leaped = true end
        local gap = math.abs(hy - h.y) - (cfg.hero_hh + sp.h * 0.5)
        if gap <= cfg.near_margin then h.near = true end
      end
    end
  end
  return in_slow
end

local function move_hazards(s, scroll_px, dt)
  local mdt = (s.dev and s.dev_paused) and 0 or dt   -- dev pause freezes all motion
  local keep = {}
  for _, h in ipairs(s.hazards) do
    if h.stairs then
      h.y = h.y - scroll_px * mdt
    else
      h.x = h.x - s.dir * scroll_px * mdt
      if h.spec.behavior == "fall" then
        h.warn_t = math.max(0, h.warn_t - mdt)
        local gap = s.dir * (h.x - s.hero_x)
        if h.warn_t == 0 and gap / math.max(1, scroll_px) <= (h.y - cfg.hero_y) / h.spec.speed then h.falling = true end
        if h.falling then BEHAVIOR.fall(s, h, mdt) end
      else
        (BEHAVIOR[h.spec.behavior] or BEHAVIOR.static)(s, h, mdt)
      end
    end
    local margin = math.max(160, h.spec.w / 2 + 32)
    local off = (not h.stairs and ((s.dir == 1 and h.x < -margin) or (s.dir == -1 and h.x > cfg.disp_w + margin))) or (h.y + h.spec.h / 2 < 0)
    if h.dead or off then
      if off and h.group == "danger" and h.threatened and not h.hit and not s.dev then  -- dodged a real threat: build the combo
        local points = cfg.score_dodge + (h.near and cfg.score_near or 0) + (h.leaped and cfg.score_leap or 0)
        if scoring.reward(s.points, "dodge:" .. h.event_id, points, true) then
          local f = s.facts
          f.dodges = f.dodges + 1
          if h.near then f.nears = f.nears + 1 end
          if h.leaped then f.leaps = f.leaps + 1 end
          f.best_combo = math.max(f.best_combo, s.points.combo)
        end
      end
      emit(s, "removed", { h = h })
    else
      table.insert(keep, h)
    end
  end
  s.hazards = keep
end

local function jump(s)
  if s.airborne or s.stride.fallen then return end
  s.airborne = true
  s.jump_t = 0
  local leap = s.speed >= cfg.leap_speed
  s.leaping = leap
  local apex = leap and cfg.leap_apex or cfg.jump_apex
  local dur = leap and cfg.leap_dur or cfg.jump_dur
  if leap then s.stride:boost(cfg.leap_boost) end
  s.jump_apex, s.jump_dur = apex, dur * 2
  s.taught_jump = true
  sfx(s, "jump")
end

-- ---------- environment + cutscenes ----------

local function apply_env(s, env)
  if env == s.env then return end
  if not (s.stage.envs and s.stage.envs[env]) then return end
  s.env = env
  emit(s, "env", { env = env })
end

local function play_cut(s, id)
  local seq = CUT[id]
  if not seq then return end
  s.cut = { id = id, steps = seq.steps, i = 1, t = 0, skippable = seq.skippable ~= false }
  emit(s, "cut", { active = true })
  M.clear_input(s)
end

local function finish_cut(s)
  s.cut = nil
  emit(s, "cut", { active = false })
  M.clear_input(s)
end

local function advance_cut(s, dt)
  local cut = s.cut
  cut.t = cut.t + dt
  if cut.t >= cut.steps[cut.i].dur then
    cut.i = cut.i + 1; cut.t = 0
    if cut.i > #cut.steps then finish_cut(s) end
  end
end

local function skip_cut(s)
  if s.cut and s.cut.skippable then finish_cut(s) end
end

local function process_events(s, evs)
  for _, ev in ipairs(evs) do
    if ev.type == "tune" then
      if ev.scroll_mult then s.scroll_mult = ev.scroll_mult end   -- inherit when omitted (goal/beat keep the sprint speed; no finish-line snap)
      if ev.drain ~= nil then s.drain = ev.drain end   -- inherit when a segment omits drain (0 is authorable)
      s.wind = ev.wind or 0
      s.substage = ev.substage
      local mode = ev.kind == "stairs" and "stairs" or "run"
      if mode ~= s.mode then
        clear_hazards(s)
        M.clear_input(s)
        s.airborne = false
        s.stride = stride.new()
        s.mode = mode
      end
      s.tutorial = ev.tutorial
      if mode == "stairs" then s.stair = stairs.new() end
      if ev.dir and ev.dir ~= s.dir then            -- floor flip (zigzag climb); hidden by the beat
        s.dir = ev.dir
        s.hero_x = home_x(s)
        clear_hazards(s)
      end
      if ev.env then apply_env(s, ev.env) end
      s.hero_x = mode == "stairs" and stairs.x[s.stair.lane] or home_x(s)
      if ev.cutscene then play_cut(s, ev.cutscene) end
      -- the start of each real room/floor (len>0, past the very start) is a checkpoint
      if (ev.kind == "authored" or ev.kind == "procedural" or ev.kind == "stairs") and ev.at > 0 then
        s.last_checkpoint = ev.at
        -- bank the chaser lead the player earned crossing here, so respawn restores it (not the full stage-start gap)
        if s.chaser_on then s.checkpoint_chaser_gap = s.dir * (s.hero_x - s.chaser_x) end
      end
    elseif ev.type == "haz" or ev.type == "goal" then
      spawn(s, ev.name, ev)
    end
  end
end

local function build_spawn(s)
  s.spawn = spawner.build(s.stage, cfg.seed, difficulty.for_stage(s.stage.number))
end

-- Respawn at a checkpoint distance: clear the field, rewind the spawner cursor so the
-- room re-spawns, restore the active env/dir/tuning there, partial meter. Keeps score.
local function respawn(s, dist)
  clear_hazards(s)
  s.distance = dist
  s.goal_reach = nil
  s.meter = cfg.checkpoint_meter
  s.stride = stride.new()
  s.speed = s.stride.speed
  s.airborne = false
  s.hero_y, s.camera_y = cfg.hero_y, 0
  s.stumble_t = 0
  scoring.hit(s.points)
  M.clear_input(s)
  s.clench = { active = false, t = 0, cd = 0 }
  build_spawn(s)
  local st = spawner.seek(s.spawn, dist)
  s.scroll_mult = st.scroll_mult or 1
  s.drain = st.drain or cfg.drain
  s.wind = st.wind or 0
  s.substage = st.substage or s.substage
  s.mode = st.kind == "stairs" and "stairs" or "run"
  s.tutorial = st.tutorial
  if s.mode == "stairs" then s.stair = stairs.new() end
  if st.dir and st.dir ~= s.dir then s.dir = st.dir end
  s.hero_x = home_x(s)
  if s.mode == "stairs" then s.hero_x = stairs.x[s.stair.lane] end
  if st.env then s.env = nil; apply_env(s, st.env) end
  if s.chaser_on then s.chaser_x = s.hero_x - s.dir * (s.checkpoint_chaser_gap or s.stage.chaser.start or 520) end
  s.run_state = "run"
  s.facts.respawns = s.facts.respawns + 1
  emit(s, "respawned")
  sfx(s, "hit")
end

-- death: respawn at the last checkpoint if we've passed one, else fail the run
local function fail_or_respawn(s)
  if s.last_checkpoint and s.last_checkpoint > 0 then
    respawn(s, s.last_checkpoint)
  else
    s.run_state = "fail"; s.end_t = 0
    emit(s, "failed")
  end
end

-- ---------- lifecycle ----------

-- Starts `stage_id` from its opening. The controller sets presentation-only flags
-- (dev, autorun) on `s` before calling.
function M.new_run(s, stage_id)
  s.events = s.events or {}
  s.hazards = s.hazards or {}
  clear_hazards(s)
  finish_cut(s)
  s.stage_id = stage_id
  s.stage = stages.get(stage_id)
  s.dir = s.stage.dir or 1
  s.hero_x = home_x(s)
  s.stride = stride.new()
  s.speed = s.stride.speed
  s.meter = 1.0
  s.distance = 0
  s.run_time = 0
  s.goal_reach = nil
  s.points = scoring.new()
  s.facts = M.new_facts()
  s.clean_strides = 0
  s.taught_jump, s.taught_clench = false, false
  s.mode = "run"
  s.stumble_t = 0
  s.max_scored = 0                 -- furthest distance scored; respawn rewinds distance but not this (no re-scoring covered ground)
  s.checkpoint_chaser_gap = nil
  s.last_checkpoint = 0
  s.run_state = "run"
  s.env = nil
  s.scroll_mult, s.drain, s.wind, s.substage = 1, cfg.drain, 0, 1
  s.clench = { active = false, t = 0, cd = 0 }
  s.end_t = 0
  s.airborne = false
  s.jump_t, s.leaping, s.jump_apex, s.jump_dur = 0, false, 0, 1
  s.hero_y, s.camera_y = cfg.hero_y, 0
  s.auto_t, s.auto_side = 0, "R"
  -- seeded timeline; apply the opening tune (env + tuning) immediately, then intro
  build_spawn(s)
  process_events(s, spawner.advance(s.spawn, 0))
  -- chaser (tsunami water-wall): starts behind the hero; catching the hero = fail
  s.chaser_on = s.stage.chaser ~= nil
  s.chaser_x = s.chaser_on and (s.hero_x - s.dir * (s.stage.chaser.start or 520)) or nil
  play_cut(s, s.stage.intro)
end

-- ---------- input ----------

local function do_stride(s, side)
  if s.airborne then return end
  if s.mode == "stairs" then
    stairs.select(s.stair, side)
    s.hero_x = stairs.x[s.stair.lane]
    return
  end
  local elapsed = s.stride.time_since_last
  local repeated = s.stride.last_side == side
  s.stride:stride(side)
  if repeated then s.stumble_t = .25 end
  local accepted = not repeated and not s.stride.fallen and elapsed >= s.stride.cfg.min_stride_interval
  if accepted then s.clean_strides = s.clean_strides + 1; sfx(s, "step") end
  if not s.dev then scoring.stride(s.points, accepted, s.distance) end
end
M.do_stride = do_stride

local function press(s, side)
  s.down[side] = true                       -- track held keys even during a cutscene (so fly works after)
  if s.cut or s.run_state ~= "run" then return end
  if s.mode == "stairs" then do_stride(s, side)
  elseif s.down.L and s.down.R then s.pending_stride = nil
  else s.pending_stride = { side = side, t = 0 } end
end

local function release(s, side)
  if s.pending_stride and s.pending_stride.side == side then
    s.pending_stride = nil
    if not s.cut then do_stride(s, side) end
  end
  s.down[side] = false
  if not (s.down.L or s.down.R) then s.jump_armed = true end
end

local function try_clench(s)
  local c = s.clench
  if s.run_state == "run" and not s.cut and not c.active and c.cd <= 0 then
    c.active = true; c.t = cfg.clench_dur
    s.taught_clench = true
    s.facts.clenches = s.facts.clenches + 1
    sfx(s, "clench")
    if not s.dev then scoring.clench(s.points, s.distance) end
  end
end

-- Applies one input code at once. The controller sends only codes valid for the
-- current screen; a ranked replay applies the recorded codes before each tick.
function M.input(s, code)
  if code == M.L_DOWN then press(s, "L")
  elseif code == M.L_UP then release(s, "L")
  elseif code == M.R_DOWN then press(s, "R")
  elseif code == M.R_UP then release(s, "R")
  elseif code == M.CLENCH then if s.cut then skip_cut(s) else try_clench(s) end
  elseif code == M.SKIP then skip_cut(s)
  elseif code == M.CLEAR then M.clear_input(s)
  elseif code >= 7 and code <= 10 then
    local l, r = (code - 7) % 2 == 1, code >= 9
    s.down.L, s.down.R = l, r
    if l and r then s.pending_stride = nil end
    if not (l or r) then s.jump_armed = true end
  end
end

-- ---------- tick ----------

function M.tick(s)
  local dt = M.DT
  s.stumble_t = math.max(0, s.stumble_t - dt)
  s.scroll_px = 0
  if s.cut then advance_cut(s, dt); return end
  if s.run_state ~= "run" then return end

  if s.pending_stride then
    s.pending_stride.t = s.pending_stride.t + dt
    if s.pending_stride.t >= cfg.jump_hold then
      local side = s.pending_stride.side
      s.pending_stride = nil
      do_stride(s, side)
    end
  end

  if s.autorun then
    s.auto_t = s.auto_t + dt
    if s.auto_t >= cfg.auto_interval then
      s.auto_t = s.auto_t - cfg.auto_interval
      s.auto_side = s.auto_side == "L" and "R" or "L"
      s.stride:stride(s.auto_side)
    end
  end

  s.run_time = s.run_time + dt

  -- meter + clench
  local c = s.clench
  if c.active then
    c.t = c.t - dt
    if c.t <= 0 then c.active = false; c.cd = cfg.clench_cd end
  else
    if c.cd > 0 then c.cd = c.cd - dt end
    if not s.dev and not (s.tutorial == "walk" and s.clean_strides < 4) then s.meter = s.meter - s.drain * dt end
  end
  if s.meter <= 0 then
    s.meter = 0
    fail_or_respawn(s)
    return
  end

  s.speed = s.airborne and s.stride.speed or s.stride:update(dt)

  -- headwind (typhoon): continuously bleeds momentum until you stride through it
  if s.wind and s.wind > 0 then
    s.stride.speed = math.max(s.stride.cfg.speed_floor, s.stride.speed - s.wind * dt)
  end

  local hy = cfg.hero_y
  if s.airborne then
    s.jump_t = s.jump_t + dt
    local phase = math.min(1, s.jump_t / s.jump_dur)
    hy = hy + 4 * s.jump_apex * phase * (1 - phase)
    if phase == 1 then s.airborne = false end
  elseif s.stride.fallen then hy = hy - cfg.fall_drop end
  s.hero_y = hy
  s.camera_y = math.max(0, hy + 160 - (cfg.disp_h - 84))

  -- jump-hold (both legs held past the threshold)
  if s.mode ~= "stairs" and s.down.L and s.down.R then
    s.both_held_t = s.both_held_t + dt
    if s.both_held_t >= cfg.jump_hold and s.jump_armed and not s.airborne then
      s.jump_armed = false
      jump(s)
    end
  else
    s.both_held_t = 0
  end

  local sp = s.stride.speed
  s.speed = sp

  -- scroll world + hazards at the current momentum x the segment's multiplier.
  -- Dev mode flies the world instead (paused = frozen, stride key held = turbo).
  local scroll_px = sp * cfg.scroll_max * (s.scroll_mult or 1)
  if s.mode == "stairs" then scroll_px = cfg.stairs_speed end
  if s.dev then
    local turbo = (s.down.L or s.down.R) and cfg.dev_turbo or 1
    scroll_px = s.dev_paused and 0 or (cfg.dev_fly * turbo)
  end
  s.scroll_px = scroll_px
  move_hazards(s, scroll_px, dt)
  if collide(s) then s.stride.speed = math.min(s.stride.speed, cfg.slow_cap) end
  if s.meter <= 0 then s.meter = 0; fail_or_respawn(s); return end

  -- chaser closes the gap when you slow (scroll < its speed) and falls back when you sprint
  if s.chaser_on then
    local mdt = (s.dev and s.dev_paused) and 0 or dt
    s.chaser_x = s.chaser_x + s.dir * ((s.stage.chaser.speed or 360) - scroll_px) * mdt
    if (not s.dev) and s.dir * (s.chaser_x - s.hero_x) >= 0 then
      fail_or_respawn(s)
      return
    end
  end

  -- advance the seeded timeline by distance (+ score for ground covered, not in dev)
  s.distance = s.distance + scroll_px * dt
  if not s.dev and s.distance > s.max_scored then   -- score only NEW ground; replaying a room after respawn earns nothing
    scoring.distance(s.points, s.distance)
    s.max_scored = s.distance
  end
  process_events(s, spawner.advance(s.spawn, s.distance))

  -- reaching the goal point ends the level (win) whether or not the goal was touched.
  if s.goal_reach and s.run_state == "run" and not s.dev and s.distance >= s.goal_reach then
    s.run_state = "win"
    s.facts.cleared = s.stage.number
    emit(s, "won", { score = math.floor(s.points.value), run_time = s.run_time })
    sfx(s, "win")
    play_cut(s, stages.next(s.stage_id) and (s.stage_id .. "_outro") or "relief")
  end
end

-- ---------- save / load ----------

local SAVED = {
  "stage_id", "dir", "hero_x", "hero_y", "speed", "meter", "distance", "run_time", "goal_reach",
  "clean_strides", "taught_jump", "taught_clench", "mode", "both_held_t", "jump_armed",
  "max_scored", "checkpoint_chaser_gap", "last_checkpoint", "run_state", "end_t", "scroll_mult",
  "drain", "wind", "substage", "tutorial", "airborne", "jump_t", "leaping", "jump_apex",
  "jump_dur", "chaser_on", "chaser_x", "env", "points", "down", "pending_stride", "clench",
  "stair", "facts",
}
local STRIDE = { "speed", "last_side", "time_since_last", "fallen", "fall_timer" }
local HAZARD = { "x", "y", "name", "group", "hit", "dead", "event_id", "stairs", "warned", "warn_t",
  "falling", "threatened", "near", "leaped" }

local function copy(value)
  if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
  local out = {}
  for k, v in pairs(value) do out[k] = copy(v) end
  return out
end

local function pick(src, keys)
  local out = {}
  for _, k in ipairs(keys) do out[k] = copy(src[k]) end
  return out
end

-- Plain data: everything that decides the rest of the run.
function M.save(s)
  local data = pick(s, SAVED)
  data.stride = pick(s.stride, STRIDE)
  data.spawn_i = s.spawn.i
  data.hazards = {}
  for i, h in ipairs(s.hazards) do data.hazards[i] = pick(h, HAZARD) end
  if s.cut then data.cut = { id = s.cut.id, i = s.cut.i, t = s.cut.t, skippable = s.cut.skippable } end
  return data
end

function M.load(s, data)
  for _, k in ipairs(SAVED) do s[k] = copy(data[k]) end
  s.stage = stages.get(s.stage_id)
  s.stride = stride.new()
  for _, k in ipairs(STRIDE) do s.stride[k] = data.stride[k] end
  build_spawn(s)
  s.spawn.i = data.spawn_i
  s.hazards = {}
  for i, h in ipairs(data.hazards) do
    s.hazards[i] = copy(h)
    s.hazards[i].spec = hazards[h.name]
  end
  s.cut = nil
  if data.cut then
    s.cut = copy(data.cut)
    s.cut.steps = CUT[data.cut.id].steps
  end
  s.events, s.touches = {}, {}
  s.stumble_t, s.camera_y = 0, 0
  return s
end

return M
modules.modules.spawner:
-- Pure, seeded spawner. Pre-builds a deterministic event timeline for a stage at a
-- given seed + difficulty, then yields events as the run's distance advances. Same
-- (stage, seed, difficulty) -> identical timeline (daily-seed runs + headless tests).
-- tools/sim_spawn.js is a faithful JS twin asserting determinism + density scaling.
--
-- Event types:
--   "tune"  segment entered: substage, scroll_mult, drain, env, cutscene
--   "haz"   spawn hazard `name` (looked up in modules/hazards.lua)
--   "goal"  spawn the goal `name` (reaching it wins the stage)
local M = {}

-- Park-Miller LCG; same constants in the JS twin so timelines match bit-for-bit.
local function lcg(seed)
  seed = (seed and seed ~= 0) and seed or 1   -- match the JS twin (seed||1): 0 maps to 1, not a distinct stream
  local s = math.floor(seed) % 2147483647
  if s <= 0 then s = s + 2147483646 end
  return function()
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    return s / 2147483647
  end
end

-- weighted pick from an ORDERED list {{name, weight}, ...} (ordered = deterministic)
local function pick(rng, mix)
  local total = 0
  for i = 1, #mix do total = total + mix[i][2] end
  local r = rng() * total
  for i = 1, #mix do
    r = r - mix[i][2]
    if r <= 0 then return mix[i][1] end
  end
  return mix[#mix][1]
end

-- difficulty compresses procedural intervals (denser) with a sane floor.
local function scaled_interval(interval, difficulty)
  local iv = (interval or 250) / (difficulty or 1)
  return iv < 90 and 90 or iv
end

function M.build(stage, seed, difficulty)
  local rng = lcg(seed)
  local tl, base = {}, 0
  local function add(e) e.seq = #tl + 1; tl[#tl + 1] = e end
  for si, seg in ipairs(stage.segments) do
    add({ at = base, type = "tune", substage = si, kind = seg.kind, scroll_mult = seg.scroll_mult,
          drain = seg.drain, env = seg.env, cutscene = seg.cutscene, dir = seg.dir, wind = seg.wind, tutorial = seg.tutorial })
    if seg.kind == "authored" or seg.kind == "stairs" then
      local ev = seg.events or {}
      for i = 1, #ev do add({ at = base + ev[i].at, type = "haz", name = ev[i].haz, lane = ev[i].lane }) end
    elseif seg.kind == "procedural" then
      local iv = scaled_interval(seg.interval, difficulty)
      local at = iv
      while at < (seg.len or 0) do
        add({ at = base + at, type = "haz", name = pick(rng, seg.mix) })
        at = at + iv
      end
    elseif seg.kind == "goal" then
      add({ at = base, type = "goal", name = seg.haz or "toilet" })
    end
    base = base + (seg.len or 0)
  end
  -- total order: at, then tune-first, then build order. Sorted by hand because the
  -- ranked verifier bans table.sort; events arrive nearly in order, so insertion is cheap.
  local function before(a, b)
    if a.at ~= b.at then return a.at < b.at end
    local pa = (a.type == "tune") and 0 or 1
    local pb = (b.type == "tune") and 0 or 1
    if pa ~= pb then return pa < pb end
    return a.seq < b.seq
  end
  for i = 2, #tl do
    local e, j = tl[i], i - 1
    while j >= 1 and before(e, tl[j]) do tl[j + 1] = tl[j]; j = j - 1 end
    tl[j + 1] = e
  end
  return { events = tl, length = base, i = 1 }
end

-- Yield events with at-distance <= dist since the last call; advances the cursor.
function M.advance(st, dist)
  local out = {}
  while st.i <= #st.events and st.events[st.i].at <= dist do
    out[#out + 1] = st.events[st.i]
    st.i = st.i + 1
  end
  return out
end

-- Fast-forward the cursor to `dist` WITHOUT emitting hazards/cutscenes (used to
-- respawn at a checkpoint): advances past every event <= dist and returns the merged
-- active tuning state there (last non-nil dir/env + the latest scroll/drain/wind).
function M.seek(st, dist)
  local s = {}
  while st.i <= #st.events and st.events[st.i].at <= dist do
    local e = st.events[st.i]
    if e.type == "tune" then
      s.scroll_mult = e.scroll_mult or s.scroll_mult   -- scroll_mult/drain inherit when a segment omits them
      s.drain = e.drain or s.drain
      s.wind = e.wind or 0                              -- wind is per-segment (process_events resets it each tune); never inherit
      s.substage = e.substage or s.substage
      s.kind, s.tutorial = e.kind, e.tutorial
      if e.dir then s.dir = e.dir end
      if e.env then s.env = e.env end
    end
    st.i = st.i + 1
  end
  return s
end

return M
modules.modules.stages:
-- Stage catalog. Each stage is ONE data row the engine plays without code changes:
-- run direction, the environments it moves through (bg/ground regions, swapped at a
-- beat), an intro cutscene, and an ordered SEGMENT list = the level's 1-D timeline.
--
-- A segment is one of:
--   authored  : hand-placed teaching beats -> events { {at=px, haz="name"}, ... }
--   procedural: seeded weighted fill -> mix { {"name", weight}, ... }, interval px
--   beat      : zero-length set piece -> cutscene id (+ env switch)
--   goal      : spawns the goal; reaching it wins
-- Every segment may carry scroll_mult (world speed × at full stride) and drain
-- (meter/sec) for hand-tuned escalation. This list IS the level editor: edit + hot-reload.
local M = {}

M.train = {
  number = 1,
  name = "The Broken Train",
  dir = -1,                         -- runs LEFT (toward the front of the train)
  envs = {
    train = { bg = "train_interior", ground = "train_floor" },
    rail  = { bg = "rail_tunnel",    ground = "rail_ground" },
  },
  intro = "train_intro",
  segments = {
    -- Cabin 1 — learn to WALK. Sparse commuters, forgiving drain.
    { kind = "authored", env = "train", len = 5000, scroll_mult = 0.85, drain = 0.006, tutorial = "walk",
      events = { { at = 1900, haz = "commuter" }, { at = 3800, haz = "commuter" } } },
    -- Cabin 2: build running rhythm through sparse commuters.
    { kind = "authored", env = "train", len = 5750, scroll_mult = 1.0, drain = 0.01, tutorial = "run",
      events = { { at = 1500, haz = "commuter" }, { at = 3100, haz = "commuter" }, { at = 4600, haz = "commuter" } } },
    -- Cabin 3: teach a jump, then introduce the rolling suitcase before the crush.
    { kind = "authored", env = "train", len = 3250, scroll_mult = 1.0, drain = 0.008, tutorial = "jump",
      events = { { at = 1100, haz = "luggage" }, { at = 2500, haz = "roller" } } },
    { kind = "procedural", env = "train", len = 7000, scroll_mult = 1.1, drain = 0.012, tutorial = "jump",
      interval = 3000, mix = { { "commuter", 3 }, { "luggage", 2 }, { "roller", 1 } } },
    -- The operator opens the front door -> cut to the rail tracks.
    { kind = "beat", env = "rail", cutscene = "door", scroll_mult = 1.0, drain = 0.01, len = 0 },
    -- Rail sprint — apply everything: gaps to leap, slick to dodge, the odd antacid for relief.
    { kind = "authored", env = "rail", len = 3000, scroll_mult = 1.0, drain = 0.008, tutorial = "clench",
      events = { { at = 1100, haz = "gap" }, { at = 2400, haz = "antacid" } } },
    { kind = "procedural", env = "rail", len = 11000, scroll_mult = 1.25, drain = 0.016,
      interval = 3000, mix = { { "gap", 3 }, { "debris", 2 }, { "slick", 1 }, { "antacid", 1 } } },
    -- Station platform toilet.
    { kind = "goal", env = "rail", haz = "toilet", len = 0 },
  },
}

-- Stage 2 — The Diner Dash. Out of the station (ticket gone, no way back) -> a street
-- run to a 24/7 diner. Runs RIGHT (contrast with the train). Signature: street traffic
-- (cars + buses); remix: cones, food carts, passersby. One street env.
M.diner = {
  number = 2,
  name = "The Diner Dash",
  dir = 1,
  envs = { street = { bg = "bg", ground = "ground" } },
  intro = "diner_intro",
  segments = {
    -- exit the station: a telegraphed cone, then the first car
    { kind = "authored", env = "street", len = 4500, scroll_mult = 0.95, drain = 0.009,
      events = { { at = 1600, haz = "cone" }, { at = 3200, haz = "car" } } },
    -- the street fills in
    { kind = "procedural", env = "street", len = 7500, scroll_mult = 1.1, drain = 0.012,
      interval = 3000, mix = { { "car", 3 }, { "cone", 2 }, { "passerby", 2 }, { "foodcart", 1 } } },
    { kind = "authored", env = "street", len = 3500, scroll_mult = 1.0, drain = 0.009,
      events = { { at = 1000, haz = "bus" }, { at = 2800, haz = "antacid" } } },
    -- rush-hour crush: buses join
    { kind = "procedural", env = "street", len = 9000, scroll_mult = 1.25, drain = 0.014,
      interval = 3000, mix = { { "car", 3 }, { "bus", 2 }, { "foodcart", 2 }, { "cone", 2 }, { "passerby", 1 }, { "antacid", 1 } } },
    { kind = "goal", env = "street", haz = "toilet", len = 0 },
  },
}

-- Stage 3 — The Office Climb. Kicked out of the diner -> a street run to the office,
-- then UP it: elevator dead, so each floor is a horizontal cross-run and each staircase
-- is a beat that FLIPS the run direction (the zigzag climb: left across 3rd, right across
-- 8th, left to 9th). Signature: rolling chairs; remix: desks, wet floors, coworkers.
-- Stair segments use vertical scrolling with authored left/right hazard lanes.
M.office = {
  number = 3,
  name = "The Office Climb",
  dir = 1,
  envs = {
    street = { bg = "bg", ground = "ground" },
    office = { bg = "office_interior", ground = "office_floor" },
    stairs = { bg = "stairs_bg", ground = "office_floor" },
  },
  intro = "office_intro",
  segments = {
    -- street to the office (it looms ahead)
    { kind = "authored", env = "street", dir = 1, len = 4500, scroll_mult = 1.0, drain = 0.01,

-- Catch malformed levels: unknown hazard/env/cutscene refs, missing goal, bad lengths.
-- Returns a list of issue strings (empty = clean). Called at init in dev so a typo in a
-- stage row fails loudly instead of erroring mid-run.
function M.validate()
  local hazards = require "modules.hazards"
  local cuts = require "modules.cutscenes"
  local stairs = require "modules.stairs"
  local issues = {}
  local function bad(msg) issues[#issues + 1] = msg end
  for _, id in ipairs(M.order) do
    local s = M[id]
    if not s then bad(id .. ": missing stage row")
    else
      if not cuts[s.intro] then bad(id .. ": missing or unknown intro '" .. tostring(s.intro) .. "'")
      elseif cuts[s.intro].skippable ~= true then bad(id .. ": intro must be skippable") end
      if s.dir ~= -1 and s.dir ~= 1 then bad(id .. ": invalid direction") end
      local has_goal = false
      for i, seg in ipairs(s.segments or {}) do
        local tag = id .. " seg" .. i
        if seg.env and not (s.envs and s.envs[seg.env]) then bad(tag .. ": unknown env '" .. tostring(seg.env) .. "'") end
        if seg.cutscene and not cuts[seg.cutscene] then bad(tag .. ": unknown cutscene '" .. tostring(seg.cutscene) .. "'") end
        if type(seg.len) ~= "number" or seg.len < 0 or seg.len ~= seg.len or seg.len == math.huge then bad(tag .. ": invalid length") end
        if seg.dir and seg.dir ~= -1 and seg.dir ~= 1 then bad(tag .. ": invalid direction") end
        if seg.drain and (type(seg.drain) ~= "number" or seg.drain < 0) then bad(tag .. ": invalid drain") end
        if seg.kind == "goal" then
          has_goal = true
          if not hazards[seg.haz or "toilet"] or hazards[seg.haz or "toilet"].group ~= "goal" then bad(tag .. ": invalid goal hazard") end
          if i ~= #s.segments then bad(tag .. ": goal must be last") end
        elseif seg.kind == "authored" or seg.kind == "stairs" then
          for _, e in ipairs(seg.events or {}) do
            if not hazards[e.haz] then bad(tag .. ": unknown haz '" .. tostring(e.haz) .. "'") end
            if type(e.at) ~= "number" or e.at ~= e.at or e.at < 0 or type(seg.len) ~= "number" or e.at >= seg.len then bad(tag .. ": event outside segment") end
            if seg.kind == "stairs" and not stairs.x[e.lane] then bad(tag .. ": invalid stair lane") end
          end
        elseif seg.kind == "procedural" then
          if type(seg.interval) ~= "number" or seg.interval ~= seg.interval or seg.interval == math.huge or seg.interval <= 0 then bad(tag .. ": invalid interval") end
          local total = 0
          for _, m in ipairs(seg.mix or {}) do
            if not hazards[m[1]] then bad(tag .. ": unknown haz '" .. tostring(m[1]) .. "'") end
            if type(m[2]) ~= "number" or m[2] ~= m[2] or m[2] == math.huge or m[2] <= 0 then bad(tag .. ": invalid weight")
            else total = total + m[2] end
          end
          if total <= 0 then bad(tag .. ": procedural mix is empty/weightless (pick() would crash)") end
        elseif seg.kind ~= "beat" then bad(tag .. ": unknown segment kind") end
      end
      if not has_goal then bad(id .. ": no goal segment") end
    end
  end
  return issues
end

return M
modules.modules.stride:
-- Alternating-stride momentum state machine — EBAKUW8's core mechanic.
-- Pure Lua, no engine calls, so tools/sim_stride.js can mirror the exact same
-- curve and assert it headlessly. `speed` is normalized 0..1; the controller
-- maps it to world-scroll px/s and to the hero's run-animation playback rate.
--
-- Rhythm rules:
--   alternate L/R cleanly      -> walk, then climb the curve to a full sprint
--   no input                   -> coast, then decay to a standstill (floor 0)
--   wrong button (same side)   -> stumble: slow down at a walk, FALL at a sprint
--   too-slow alternation       -> quality tapers, decay wins, drift back down
--   sub-human mash (< min)     -> no credit (can't auto-fire to the top)
-- A fall stuns you (speed 0) for fall_recovery seconds, then you restart cold.
local M = {}
M.__index = M

local DEFAULTS = {
  accel_per_stride    = 0.16,  -- base gain per clean alternating stride (pre-curve)
  walk_speed          = 0.18,
  max_speed           = 1.0,
  decay_rate          = 0.6,   -- speed/sec bled toward the floor once cadence lapses
  ideal_stride_window = 0.22,  -- slowest cadence (s) that still earns full credit
  min_stride_interval = 0.06,  -- faster than this = buzzer-mash, zero credit
  speed_floor         = 0.0,   -- no input -> dead stop; must stride to move
  same_side_penalty   = 0.2,   -- speed dropped when the same leg fires (below fall_speed)
  grace_window        = 0.35,  -- no decay until this long without a stride
  fall_speed          = 0.45,  -- a cadence break at/above this speed makes you fall
  fall_recovery       = 0.9,   -- seconds stunned on the ground before you can run again
}

function M.new(cfg)
  local self = setmetatable({}, M)
  self.cfg = {}
  for k, v in pairs(DEFAULTS) do
    self.cfg[k] = (cfg and cfg[k] ~= nil) and cfg[k] or v
  end
  self.speed = self.cfg.speed_floor
  self.last_side = "none"
  self.time_since_last = 0
  self.fallen = false
  self.fall_timer = 0
  return self
end

-- Timing quality 0..1 for an alternating stride arriving `dt` after the last:
-- full credit for fast-but-human cadence, tapering once you dawdle past ideal,
-- zero for inhuman mashing.
local function quality(cfg, dt)
  if dt < cfg.min_stride_interval then return 0 end
  if dt <= cfg.ideal_stride_window then return 1 end
  local q = 1 - (dt - cfg.ideal_stride_window) / cfg.ideal_stride_window
  return q > 0 and q or 0
end

-- Call every frame. Runs the fall timer, else bleeds speed toward the floor once
-- cadence lapses. Returns the current speed.
function M:update(dt)
  if self.fallen then
    self.fall_timer = self.fall_timer - dt
    if self.fall_timer <= 0 then
      self.fallen = false
      self.last_side = "none"      -- get up cold; rebuild the rhythm
      self.time_since_last = 0
    end
    self.speed = self.cfg.speed_floor
    return self.speed
  end
  self.time_since_last = self.time_since_last + dt
  if self.time_since_last > self.cfg.grace_window then
    self.speed = self.speed - self.cfg.decay_rate * dt
    if self.speed < self.cfg.speed_floor then self.speed = self.cfg.speed_floor end
  end
  return self.speed
end

-- Register a leg input ("L" or "R"). Returns the resulting speed.
function M:stride(side)
  if self.fallen then return self.speed end
  local dt = self.time_since_last
  if side == self.last_side then
    if self.speed >= self.cfg.fall_speed then
      self.fallen = true                 -- stumble at a sprint = faceplant
      self.fall_timer = self.cfg.fall_recovery
      self.speed = self.cfg.speed_floor
    else
      self.speed = self.speed - self.cfg.same_side_penalty
      if self.speed < self.cfg.speed_floor then self.speed = self.cfg.speed_floor end
    end
  else
    local headroom = 1 - self.speed / self.cfg.max_speed
    self.speed = self.speed + self.cfg.accel_per_stride * headroom * quality(self.cfg, dt)
    if dt >= self.cfg.min_stride_interval then self.speed = math.max(self.cfg.walk_speed, self.speed) end
    if self.speed > self.cfg.max_speed then self.speed = self.cfg.max_speed end
  end
  self.last_side = side
  self.time_since_last = 0
  return self.speed
end

-- One-off speed bump (a leap's forward momentum). Ignored while down.
function M:boost(amount)
  if self.fallen then return self.speed end
  self.speed = self.speed + amount
  if self.speed > self.cfg.max_speed then self.speed = self.cfg.max_speed end
  if self.speed < self.cfg.speed_floor then self.speed = self.cfg.speed_floor end
  return self.speed
end

return M
modules.scoreosis.codec:
-- Canonical, exact encoding of plain Lua data, shared by game clients and the
-- Scoreosis verifier. Numbers round-trip bit for bit; table keys are sorted,
-- so equal states always encode to equal strings.
local M = {}

local floor, frexp, ldexp, format = math.floor, math.frexp, math.ldexp, string.format
local concat, sort, byte, sub, find = table.concat, table.sort, string.byte, string.sub, string.find
local TWO53 = 9007199254740992
local NEG_ZERO = -1 / math.huge

local function encode_number(x)
	if x ~= x then return "N" end
	if x == math.huge then return "I" end
	if x == -math.huge then return "J" end
	if x == floor(x) and x > -TWO53 and x < TWO53 then
		if x == 0 and 1 / x < 0 then return "m" end
		return "i" .. format("%.0f", x) .. ";"
	end
	local m, e = frexp(x)
	return "f" .. format("%.0f", m * TWO53) .. "," .. format("%.0f", e - 53) .. ";"
end

local function key_less(a, b)
	local ta, tb = type(a), type(b)
	if ta ~= tb then return ta < tb end
	return a < b
end

local encode_value

local function encode_table(t, out, depth)
	if depth > 64 then error("codec: nesting too deep") end
	local keys = {}
	for k in pairs(t) do
		local kt = type(k)
		if kt ~= "string" and kt ~= "number" then error("codec: unsupported key type " .. kt) end
		keys[#keys + 1] = k
	end
	sort(keys, key_less)
	out[#out + 1] = "{"
	for i = 1, #keys do
		local k = keys[i]
		encode_value(k, out, depth)
		encode_value(t[k], out, depth)
	end
	out[#out + 1] = "}"
end

function encode_value(v, out, depth)
	local tv = type(v)
	if tv == "number" then
		out[#out + 1] = encode_number(v)
	elseif tv == "string" then
		out[#out + 1] = "s" .. #v .. ":" .. v
	elseif tv == "boolean" then
		out[#out + 1] = v and "t" or "b"
	elseif tv == "table" then
		encode_table(v, out, depth + 1)
	else
		error("codec: unsupported value type " .. tv)
	end
end

function M.encode(v)
	local out = {}
	encode_value(v, out, 0)
	return concat(out)
end

local function read_until(s, pos, ch)
	local stop = find(s, ch, pos, true)
	if not stop then error("codec: truncated input") end
	return sub(s, pos, stop - 1), stop + 1
end

local decode_value

function decode_value(s, pos, depth)
	local tag = sub(s, pos, pos)
	pos = pos + 1
	if tag == "i" then
		local digits, nxt = read_until(s, pos, ";")
		return tonumber(digits), nxt
	elseif tag == "f" then
		local body, nxt = read_until(s, pos, ";")
		local comma = find(body, ",", 1, true)
		return ldexp(tonumber(sub(body, 1, comma - 1)), tonumber(sub(body, comma + 1))), nxt
	elseif tag == "m" then
		return NEG_ZERO, pos
	elseif tag == "N" then
		return 0 / 0, pos
	elseif tag == "I" then
		return math.huge, pos
	elseif tag == "J" then
		return -math.huge, pos
	elseif tag == "t" then
		return true, pos
	elseif tag == "b" then
		return false, pos
	elseif tag == "s" then
		local len, start = read_until(s, pos, ":")
		local n = tonumber(len)
		return sub(s, start, start + n - 1), start + n
	elseif tag == "{" then
		if depth > 64 then error("codec: nesting too deep") end
		local t = {}
		while sub(s, pos, pos) ~= "}" do
			if pos > #s then error("codec: truncated input") end
			local k, v
			k, pos = decode_value(s, pos, depth + 1)
			v, pos = decode_value(s, pos, depth + 1)
			t[k] = v
		end
		return t, pos + 1
	end
	error("codec: bad tag at " .. (pos - 1))
end

function M.decode(s)
	local v, pos = decode_value(s, 1, 0)
	if pos ~= #s + 1 then error("codec: trailing data") end
	return v
end

-- Polynomial checksum mod 2^31-1; exact in doubles, needs no bit library.
function M.checksum(s)
	local h = 7
	for i = 1, #s, 64 do
		local chunk = { byte(s, i, i + 63) }
		for j = 1, #chunk do h = (h * 257 + chunk[j]) % 2147483647 end
	end
	return h
end

-- Inputs travel as "count:bits,count:bits" run-length pairs, one bitmask per tick.
function M.encode_inputs(ticks)
	local out, run, last = {}, 0, nil
	for i = 1, #ticks do
		local bits = ticks[i]
		if bits == last then
			run = run + 1
		else
			if last then out[#out + 1] = run .. ":" .. last end
			last, run = bits, 1
		end
	end
	if last then out[#out + 1] = run .. ":" .. last end
	return concat(out, ",")
end

return M
